subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94139 the canonical fix path for this Telegram native-vision issue, or require a different shared media hydration contract before this issue closes?
rationale: The issue is valid and current main is not fully fixed, but the open PR changes the partial-image delivery contract and still lacks live Telegram proof, so automation should not choose that contract alone.

options.title: Review and prove the linked PR
options.body: Treat the open linked PR as the candidate fix, require the ordering/source-index contract and real Telegram or equivalent proof, then close this issue only after merge.

options.title: Define a broader shared media fix
options.body: If the linked PR is too narrow, keep this issue canonical and ask for a replacement fix covering absolute-path, partial-batch, and channel-media behavior together.

options.title: Wait for live repro first
options.body: If maintainers are unsure the current source gap matches the reporter's Windows Telegram setup, keep the issue open until a credentialed live repro confirms the exact failure.

recommendation.title: Review and prove the linked PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open linked PR as the candidate fix, require the ordering/source-index contract and real Telegram or equivalent proof, then close this issue only after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related Telegram media fix and current-turn hydration committer history make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the maintainer decision.
